post.description:
Soft-delete (disable) a user account. Requires ``auth.delete_user``.

Sets the profile ``deleted_at`` marker; it never hard-deletes the row, never
anonymizes, and never unbinds a provider identity — those are distinct
lifecycle actions with their own contracts.

Grant local CTF Organizer to a user (grant-only). Requires ``auth.change_user``.

Additive and audited with ``local`` provenance by
``config.organizer_authority`` (its own strict ROLE_SYNC audit), so provider
reconciliation never auto-revokes it. Local revocation has no complete
service contract and is intentionally not offered here.

Restore a soft-deleted risk.

Bypasses ``self.get_object()`` (which uses the active-only
SoftDeleteManager and would 404 a deleted risk) and looks the
target up via ``Risk.all_objects`` directly. Object-level
permission checks are still enforced explicitly because we lose
the ``check_object_permissions()`` call that ``self.get_object()``
would have run on our behalf.

AcesCatalogFields.description:
Read-only, allowlisted ACES package-source presentation fields.

Every field is bounded provenance/identity metadata. This serializer never
exposes raw ACES SDL, imported module bodies, generated content, flags,
credentials, presigned URLs, provider payloads, or runtime config.

AcesImageMappingDisable.description: Shape validation for a disable request (natural key only).

AcesImageMappingRegister.description:
Shape validation for a register/upsert request; the service is final validator.

Provider-choice validity, natural-key rules, and soft-disable semantics stay
in ``engine.services`` so the API and management command cannot drift; this
serializer only enforces HTTP shape (required fields, max lengths, positive
disk size, boolean).

AcesImageMappingView.description:
Allowlisted read projection shared by the register, list, and disable responses.

Field-for-field with ``engine.services.AcesImageMappingView`` so it renders
either that DTO (list/disable) or the model instance the upsert returns.

AcesOperationRecord.description:
Read-only projection of one ACES operation sidecar record (#1275).

Serializes an ``AcesOperationRecordProjection`` (already redacted by the
shared read seam); it never touches the raw model ``payload``.

AcesOperationRecordListResponse.description: Response body shared by ``mission_control.api.aces`` list endpoints.

AcesParticipantRuntimeRecord.description:
Read-only projection of one ACES participant-runtime sidecar record (#1288).

Serializes an ``AcesParticipantRuntimeRecordProjection`` (already redacted
by the shared read seam); it never touches the raw model ``payload``.

AcesParticipantRuntimeRecordListResponse.description: Response body shared by ``mission_control.api.aces_participant`` list endpoints.

AdminUserDetail.description:
Read-only detail view: list fields plus role provenance and group names.

``groups`` are Django role group names (e.g. "CTF Organizer"), never the
provider group claims captured on the profile.

AdminUserListItem.description:
Read-only summary of a user for the Administer list.

Roles, account type, and origin are surfaced read-only; identity-binding
fields are intentionally absent.

ApiError.description:
Schema-only component for the canonical platform API error envelope.

Mirrors :func:`shared.api.errors.api_exception_handler` /
:func:`shared.api.errors.api_error_response` output. It describes the wire
contract; it never runs at request time.

ApiErrorBody.description: Schema-only description of the ``shared.api.errors`` envelope body.

details.description: Optional structured field-level detail (present on validation errors).

request_id.description: Correlation id echoed from the X-Request-ID request header, when present.

AssignBracketRequest.description:
Request body for assigning or removing a participant's bracket.

``bracket_id`` is typed loosely (nullable string) so the view keeps the
legacy branch mapping: a malformed value 400s as ``Invalid bracket ID
format``, a same-event violation 400s, an unknown bracket 404s, and ``null``
removes the current bracket.

AssignBracketResult.description: Result returned after assigning or removing a participant's bracket.

ChallengeFileUpload.description: Multipart request body for uploading a challenge attachment.

ChallengeImportError.description: One skipped import entry with its reason.

ChallengeImportRequest.description: Challenge import request: the export document itself (CTF-1101/1104).

ChallengeListResponse.description: Envelope returned by the event challenge list.

ChallengeMutationResult.description: Compact result returned after creating or updating a challenge.

ChallengeRating.description: Challenge rating projection (aggregate visible only when public).

ChallengeSummary.description: List projection of one challenge for an event.

ChallengeWrite.description:
Create/update request body for a challenge.

Declares every field the ``ctf.services.create_challenge`` /
``update_challenge`` facade consumes so nothing is silently dropped: the
mass-assignable challenge fields plus the write-only ``flag`` (plaintext),
``flags`` (multi-flag records), ``tags``, ``topics``, and ``next_challenge``.
``flag`` is intentionally optional at this layer; the service enforces the
flag-or-flags rule and raises ``CTFValidationError`` (mapped to 400).
Updates are validated ``partial=True`` by the view.

CleanupControlRequest.description: Defer or cancel the pending automated range cleanup (CTF-1003).

CredentialCreate.description: Validate credential creation requests before schema-specific validation.

CtfScenarioListResponse.description: Envelope returned by the scenario list.

CtfScenarioRef.description: A CMS scenario id/name pair available for a CTF event.

DashboardRiskRegister.description: Risk-register load summary, gated by advisory access.

DeleteSuccess.description: The ``{"success": true}`` envelope returned by service-backed deletes.

EmailTemplateWrite.description:
Request body for creating/updating a per-event email-template override.

Fields are blank-tolerant so the view keeps the legacy validation: a missing
or empty ``html_body`` / ``text_body`` and any disallowed template syntax
both surface as a controlled 400. Organizer templates are restricted to the
flat ``{{ name }}`` placeholder grammar over the per-notification-type
allowlist enforced by ``ctf.services.email_template`` (CWE-1336, issue #1095).

EventMutationResult.description: Compact result returned after creating or updating an event.

EventStaffAssignRequest.description: Assignment request: organizer-tier user email plus staff role.

EventStaffListResponse.description: Envelope for the event staff listing.

EventStaffMember.description: One delegated staff assignment on an event (CTF-607).

EventSummary.description: List projection of one of an organizer's events.

EventWrite.description:
Create/update request body: the mutable event fields only.

``status``, ``created_by``, ``id``, and timestamps are intentionally absent;
the service layer also filters to mutable fields, so mass assignment is
prevented at two layers. Updates are validated ``partial=True`` by the view.

FileDownloadResponse.description: Presigned download URL for a challenge attachment.

FlagCreateResult.description: Result returned after adding a flag (validator_config only when set).

FlagWrite.description:
Request body for adding a flag to a challenge.

Mirrors the legacy view's ``flag_data`` construction: ``flag`` is optional
here (the view enforces that a value is present for static/regex types), and
``case_sensitive`` / ``order`` / ``validator_config`` carry the same defaults
the service consumes.

ForceDeleteEventResult.description: Summary returned by a force-delete (range teardown counts).

GuacamoleBootstrapQueued.description:
Response body for a queued Guacamole bootstrap (RDP/SSH/NGFW-SSH POST, HTTP 202).

``url`` here is the compatibility opener route, not a signed session URL
(that one-time URL is delivered only by the status poll, see
``GuacamoleBootstrapStatusSerializer``).

GuacamoleBootstrapStatus.description:
Response body for ``GuacamoleBootstrapStatusView.get``.

``url`` is the one-time signed Guacamole session URL, delivered exactly
once on a ``succeeded`` poll; never given a real example. ``duration_ms``
and ``error`` are present only once the bootstrap has finished or failed.

GuacamoleInstance.description: Validate range Guacamole URL bootstrap requests.

HintListResponse.description: Envelope returned by the challenge hint list.

HintWrite.description:
Request body for adding a hint. ``penalty`` / ``order`` are optional so the
service applies its own defaults (order defaults to the current hint count).

LegacyError.description:
Schema-only description of the flat ``{"error": "<message>"}`` body some
legacy Mission Control endpoints return (e.g. Guacamole bootstrap 503/404).

This is NOT the canonical :class:`ApiErrorSerializer` envelope. It exists so
the contract describes those endpoints' real wire shape truthfully rather
than pretending they use the structured envelope. New endpoints must use the
canonical envelope; this documents existing behavior, it does not endorse it.

NotificationAnnounceRequest.description:
Request body for sending an announcement notification.

``subject`` and ``body`` are blank-tolerant at this layer so the view can
apply the legacy strip-then-reject rule and return the exact ``Invalid
notification request.`` 400 envelope for an empty or whitespace-only value.

NotificationAnnounceResult.description: Result returned after creating and sending an announcement (201).

NotificationListItem.description: List projection of one notification for an event.

NotificationListResponse.description: Envelope returned by the event notification list.

NotificationSendResult.description: Result returned after dispatching a notification to its recipients.

OrganizerChallengeRating.description: Aggregate participant rating shown to organizers (CTF-120).

OrganizerGrantResult.description: Minimal confirmation payload for a local-organizer grant.

OrganizerScoreboardResponse.description:
Organizer monitoring scoreboard — always the full ranking payload.

Unlike :class:`PublicScoreboardResponseSerializer`, this projection never
carries the ``scoreboard_hidden`` sentinel and never withholds rows: an
organizer sees every ranking regardless of the event's ``scoreboard_visible``
flag or freeze window. ``frozen`` is reported for display only; the rankings
are computed as of now (``freeze_at=None``).

PackRegistration.description:
Validate the shape of a uniform pack-registration request body (#1578).

This is a thin boundary check: it rejects missing/oversized/wrong-typed
fields so the service and the reference-record validator receive a
well-formed request. Domain validation (source-kind allowlist, digest shape,
bounded provenance, pack conformance, no-shadow) remains authoritative in the
service and model — this serializer does not restate it.

PackRegistrationResult.description: Bounded 201 summary returned after a pack is registered (#1578).

ParticipantAnnouncement.description: One sent announcement on the participant surface (CTF-803).

ParticipantAnnouncementList.description: Envelope for the participant announcement feed.

ParticipantChallengeDetail.description:
Participant-safe challenge detail for the solve view.

Never declares flag, flag-format, or validator-config fields. ``solution`` is
non-null only after the event has ended/archived.

ParticipantChallengeListItem.description:
A participant-safe browse entry for one available challenge.

Carries only what the browse list renders. No flag hash, flag format,
solution, or validator configuration is exposed.

ParticipantCurrentEvent.description: The participant's current event plus their own participant state.

ParticipantDeleteResult.description: Confirmation returned after soft-deleting a participant.

ParticipantEvent.description:
Read-only participant-facing projection of the current CTF event.

Organizer-only configuration (range config, reminder schedule, spare counts,
email templates, cleanup policy) is deliberately omitted.

ParticipantHiddenRequest.description: Target scoreboard visibility for the hidden endpoint (CTF-606).

ParticipantHint.description: A progressive hint. ``text`` is populated only when unlocked.

ParticipantImport.description:
Request body for bulk-importing participants.

``participants`` is typed as a bare list (each element validated per-item in
the view, mirroring the legacy #1149 handling) rather than a strict
``ListField(child=DictField())``: a non-list still 400s at this layer, but a
list carrying non-object elements must yield per-item errors, not a
top-level 400.

ParticipantImportError.description: One per-row import error (``email`` present only for service failures).

ParticipantImportResult.description: Summary returned by a bulk import.

ParticipantInvite.description:
Request body for inviting a single participant.

``name`` and ``email`` are both required and non-blank (mirroring the legacy
truthiness check). ``email`` is a plain ``CharField`` rather than an
``EmailField`` because the service layer owns email validation.

ParticipantInviteResult.description: Result returned after inviting a single participant.

ParticipantListResponse.description: Envelope returned by the event participant list.

ParticipantModerationRequest.description: Optional reason accompanying a ban or disqualification.

ParticipantRangeActionResult.description: Pass-through result of a single-participant range lifecycle action.

ParticipantRoleRequest.description: Target participation role for the role endpoint (CTF-604).

ParticipantSelf.description: The requesting participant's own state (never another participant's).

ParticipantSummary.description: List projection of one participant for an event.

ParticipantTeam.description: The participant's own team and its members.

ParticipantTeamMember.description: A teammate's display identity (no score or account fields).

ParticipantUsernameRequest.description: New login handle for the username-rename endpoints (#1206/#1593).

PatchedProfileUpdateRequest.description: Partial self-profile update: any omitted field is left unchanged.

stride_categories.description: List of STRIDE category codes (S, T, R, I, D, E)

PatchedScenarioMetadataUpdate.description: Metadata (availability/audience) update; both fields optional for PATCH.

PatchedScenarioUpdate.description: Structured update request: full definition replacement (no identity change).

Prerequisite.description: List projection of one challenge prerequisite.

PrerequisiteCreateResult.description: Result returned after adding a prerequisite.

PrerequisiteListResponse.description: Envelope returned by the challenge prerequisite list.

PrerequisiteWrite.description: Request body for adding a challenge prerequisite.

PublicScoreboardResponse.description:
Public scoreboard read surface.

The runtime returns one of two shapes: the ``{"scoreboard_hidden": true}``
sentinel when the event hides its scoreboard, or the full ranking payload
(``event_id``, ``team_mode``, ``frozen``, ``rankings``, ``bracket_rankings``,
``brackets``). Every field is optional so this one serializer documents the
union without changing the view's runtime ``JsonResponse``.

RangeAccessResponse.description: Redirect pointer to the mission_control Guacamole RDP endpoint.

RangeHistory.description:
One entry in the range-history list (``GET .../ranges/``, #1370).

Projects the durable identifiers off ``cms.models.RangeInstance`` without
conflating them: ``request_id`` is the durable UUID correlation key
(``None`` for pre-Request-pattern legacy rows with no linked
``cms.models.Request``); ``range_id`` is the legacy nullable integer id.

RangeHistoryResponse.description: Response body for the range-history list endpoint.

RangeLease.description: Safe, server-owned lease projection for one Mission Control range.

RangeLeaseResponse.description: Response body for one bounded Mission Control lease extension.

RangeListItem.description: A single participant's range row in the organizer range list.

RangeListResponse.description: Organizer range list plus the provisioning-progress projection.

RangePresentation.description:
Response-only projection of ``shared.schemas.RangeContext``.

Field set mirrors ``RangeContext.model_fields`` plus its computed
properties (``is_ready``, ``is_terminal``, ``is_active``).

RangeProvisionQueued.description: Acknowledgement returned when bulk range provisioning is enqueued.

RangeRecoveryRequest.description:
Organizer range-recovery request body (issue #1018).

``strategy`` and ``spare_range_instance_id`` are typed loosely so the view
keeps the legacy boundary validation (a non-string strategy or a
non-positive-int spare id both 400) while the service validates ``strategy``
against ``ctf.enums`` and resolves/validates the spare range itself.

RangeRecoveryResult.description: Result returned after a range recovery attempt.

RangeStatusResponse.description: Participant range status projection (or the not-assigned sentinel).

RangeTargetInstance.description:
A participant-safe target box in a ready range (issue #1740).

Documents the projected {uuid, name, private_ip, os_type} allowlist. The
``ctf.bridges.cms_get_range_target_instances`` projection is what enforces the
allowlist at runtime; this serializer only publishes the contract.

RateChallengeRequest.description: Participant request body for rating a challenge (1-5).

RateChallengeResult.description: Result returned after recording a challenge rating.

ResendInviteResult.description: Confirmation returned after resetting and resending a participant invite.

ScenarioCreate.description: Structured create request: identity plus definition.

ScenarioCreated.description: Response for a create/clone: the new scenario's identity.

ScenarioDetail.description:
Full scenario detail with source-capability flags for the editor.

``source`` classifies the entry (``builtin`` / ``custom`` / ``aces`` /
``ctf``) and the capability booleans tell the SPA which actions to offer.
``instances`` / ``subnets`` are populated for structural (demo) scenarios;
``aces`` carries the read-only provenance block for ACES entries.

ScenarioExport.description: Response for an export: the scenario id and its YAML rendering.

ScenarioInstance.description:
A single scenario instance, mirroring ``schema.InstanceConfig``.

Kept field-complete against the Pydantic schema so a round-trip through the
editor never silently drops instance fields (the legacy form hardcoded a
partial list). The service layer re-validates the full definition.

ScenarioListItem.description:
One entry from ``cms.services.list_launchable_scenarios``.

Legacy YAML/DB scenarios and ACES-derived catalog entries share this
projection but are not fully homogeneous; fields the SPA does not render
stay loosely typed (``DictField``/``ListField(DictField)``) rather than
modeling the full ``ScenarioTemplate``/ACES catalog schema here.

ScenarioMetadataState.description: Response for a metadata update: the resolved overlay state.

ScheduledTask.description: One scheduler row in the organizer task history (#526).

ScheduledTaskListResponse.description: Envelope for the organizer scheduled-task listing.

ScoreTimelineResponse.description: Per-participant chronological score progression for a step chart.

SendInvitationsResult.description: Result returned after queuing invitation emails for an event.

SetActiveRequest.description: Explicit request body for the activate/deactivate operation.

SparePoolRequest.description: Organizer spare-pool top-up request body (``count`` bounded non-negative).

SpareProvisionResult.description: Summary returned after topping up an event's spare-range pool.

SubmissionListItem.description: One of the requesting participant's own submissions.

SubmissionListResponse.description: Envelope returned by the participant submission history.

SubmitFlagRequest.description:
Participant request body for submitting a flag.

``flag`` is blank-tolerant at this layer so the view can apply the legacy
strip-then-reject rule and return the exact ``Could not process challenge
action.`` 400 envelope for an empty or whitespace-only flag.

SubmitFlagResult.description: Scored result returned after a flag submission.

SuccessResponse.description:
Generic ``{"success": true}`` response body.

Shared by the range lifecycle mutations (cancel/destroy/pause/resume),
upload cancel, and credential delete — every Mission Control mutation
endpoint that has no payload beyond a boolean acknowledgement.

TeamCreateRequest.description: Request body for creating a team.

TeamJoinRequest.description: Request body for joining a team by invite code.

TeamMemberRequest.description: Request body naming a teammate (transfer captaincy, remove member).

UploadInitiateResponse.description:
Response body for ``UploadInitiateView.post`` (``cms.services.initiate_upload``).

``presigned_url`` is a short-lived, single-use S3 PUT URL — an existing
response field, typed here for the schema but never given a real example.

UseHintRequest.description:
Optional body for unlocking a hint.

Omit the body (or send ``{}``) to unlock the next hint in order; pass
``hint_id`` to unlock a specific hint.

UseHintResult.description: Result returned after unlocking a hint.

Webhook.description: One registered webhook endpoint (CTF-1203); secrets never round-trip.

WebhookListResponse.description: Envelope for the event webhook listing.

YAMLValidationResult.description: Response for the YAML validate endpoint.

_NamedRef.description: A minimal ``{id, name}`` reference to a related entity.

_ProfileEventRef.description: Minimal event reference on the profile payload.

ApiTokenAuth.description: Platform API token with scopes from shared.api_tokens.scopes.
